item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las zhi khro bskang ba
item.coloph: gsas mkhar rab 'byams kyi rgyud las/ zhi khro dbyings kyi thugs dam skong ba'i yan lag bstan pa'o/ dbal gshen gsang ba'i thugs bcud/ stag la me 'bar gyis gtan la phabs (phab) nas/ lha klu mi gsum snang mdog dang bzhi la brgyud pa'o/ de la khod spungs dran pas dka' ba spyad nas zhus so/ des ldang (stang) dmu tsha gyer med la gdams pa'o//
